standard.summary: 预设的 offload 策略：balanced=平衡；aggressive=激进（最省显存）；conservative=保守（更快）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.aggressive: 多卸，峰值最低，空等也多。

standard_en.summary: Preset offload strategies: balanced = balanced; aggressive = aggressive (saves the most VRAM); conservative = conservative (faster).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.conservative: Offloads little: fast, and uses VRAM.
optionDescriptions.aggressive: Offloads a lot: the lowest peak, and plenty of idle waiting.

advanced_en.principle: Preset offload strategies: balanced = balanced; aggressive = aggressive (most VRAM saved); conservative = conservative (faster).
